# pi-voicekit

> Voice in + voice out for the Pi coding agent: hold-to-talk STT (Deepgram streaming or 21 offline models) plus TTS (Kitten Nano, Piper, Kokoro, or Deepgram Aura).

## Overview

pi-voicekit adds voice input and voice output to Pi. Hold SPACE to record, release to transcribe. Two STT backends: Deepgram (cloud, live streaming as you speak) or local models (offline, batch mode after recording). 21 local models from Parakeet, Whisper, Moonshine, SenseVoice, GigaAM, Paraformer and Qwen3 with accuracy/speed ratings and device-aware recommendations. TTS covers Kitten Nano, Piper and Kokoro (offline) plus Deepgram Aura (cloud), including auto-speak of agent responses.

## Setup

1. `pi install npm:pi-voicekit` (outside Pi)
2. Open Pi, run `/voice-settings` to choose backend
3. Deepgram: get key at https://dpgr.am/pi-voice ($200 free credit, lasts 6-12 months)
4. Local: select a model, it downloads automatically
5. Audio capture auto-detects: sox, ffmpeg, or arecord

## Commands

- `/voice-settings` — Unified settings panel (backend, models, language, device)
- `/voice-models` — Settings panel focused on Models tab
- `/voice-speak <text>` — Speak text out loud (TTS)
- `/voice-speak-models` — Browse / install TTS voice models
- `/voice-speak-info` — Diagnose TTS state
- `/voice test` — Full diagnostics (audio tool, mic, API key)
- `/voice [on|off|dictate|stop|history]`

## Components

- `extensions/voice.ts`: Main extension — state machine, recording, settings panel handler
- `extensions/voice/config.ts`: Config loading, saving, migration
- `extensions/voice/onboarding.ts`: First-run wizard, language picker
- `extensions/voice/deepgram.ts`: Deepgram STT URL builder, API key resolver
- `extensions/voice/local.ts`: Model catalog (21 models), in-process transcription
- `extensions/voice/device.ts`: Device profiling, model fitness scoring
- `extensions/voice/model-download.ts`: Download manager with resume, verification, Handy import
- `extensions/voice/sherpa-engine.ts`: sherpa-onnx bindings, recognizer lifecycle
- `extensions/voice/settings-panel.ts`: Settings panel overlay (5 tabs)
- `extensions/voice/tts-engine.ts`: TTS engine selection and synthesis
- `extensions/voice/tts-local-models.ts`: Local TTS voice catalog (Kitten, Piper, Kokoro)
- `extensions/voice/tts-deepgram.ts`: Deepgram Aura TTS (cloud)
- `extensions/voice/tts-playback.ts`: Audio playback, WAV encoding, abort handling
